name: Rookies
source:
Kusakabe Michihiko describes himself as a detective. But he never got a request so he's been working on part-time jobs. On his 30th birthday he got a request to investigate narcotics circulation in an all-girls school. His girlfriend makes him promise that this is going to be the last case if he fails.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-january-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
草壁道彦自称侦探，可他从来没有接到过委托，只能靠打零工度日。30岁生日这天，他终于得到一项任务：调查一所女子学校内的毒品流通。女友要他保证，如果这次仍然失败，就必须就此收手，不再接案。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-january-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
